{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded_count = refunded_mask.sum()

# Define the population: completed orders, excluding refunded and QA
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
valid_mask = completed_mask & ~refunded_mask & ~qa_mask

# Filter the data
df_filtered = df[valid_mask]

# Compute average revenue per order
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()
total_orders = len(df_filtered)
avg_revenue = total_revenue / total_orders

print(f'QA orders found: {qa_count}')
print(f'Refunded orders: {refunded_count}')
print(f'Valid completed orders: {total_orders}')
print(f'Average revenue per valid order: ${avg_revenue:,.2f}')

# Display sample of cleaned revenue
df_filtered[['revenue', 'revenue_clean']].head()"}
